jobs.title: Product Manager - Developer Experience, Bridge
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the team

Join our Product team to build the systems that make global, programmable money trustworthy at scale. At Bridge, we’re not just improving global payments — we’re reinventing how money moves across borders using stablecoins and modern financial infrastructure.

As a Product Manager for Developer Experience, you'll own the end-to-end developer experience from their first encounter with Bridge to transacting billions of dollars in volume on our platform. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, data, and go-to-market to build the self-serve onboarding, developer Dashboard, and activation systems that help any developer build a scaled and successful business with Bridge.

This role is about enabling a developer of any size and stage to build and scale their business successfully on Bridge. 

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end developer lifecycle and key products, spanning self-serve sign-up, KYB and onboarding, the developer Dashboard, and activation and retention programs.

Drive product features from ideation to launch in close collaboration with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams.

Design and evolve data-driven signals and systems that recognize what a developer needs at each stage and respond automatically with the right nudges, support, and interventions.

Define and own the product roadmap that creates a scalable and intuitive experience for every developer to use Bridge’s full suite products.

Define and own key developer metrics (e.g. activation rate, time-to-first-transaction, developer retention) to drive business impact.

Partner closely with go-to-market and support teams to understand developer feedback and ship improvements rapidly.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Empathy for users: You’re passionate about uncovering and solving pain points.

Deep curiosity: You never stop asking “why” and dig into both qualitative and quantitative data.

Owner’s mentality: You tackle challenges head-on and drive solutions with conviction.

Collaborative spirit: You work seamlessly with team members but aren’t afraid to make the call when needed.

Clarity and simplicity: You translate complex systems into intuitive, straightforward user experiences.

Bias for learning: You embrace mistakes as opportunities to grow and improve quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

6–10+ years of product management experience, with exposure to developer platforms, onboarding, and product-led growth.

Experience building or owning systems related to onboarding, activation, retention, or self-serve growth.

Experience operating across multiple customer segments or go-to-market motions, from self-serve to enterprise.

Comfort working with APIs, dashboards, or developer-facing platforms.

Experience in fintech, payments, or crypto.

If you’re ready to shape the future of how money moves, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Internal Audit - Regulatory Lead, EMEA
jobs.description:
Who we are 

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

To advance Stripe’s important mission, we are building a world class Internal Audit (IA) team. Our purpose is to strengthen the organization’s ability to create, protect, and sustain value by providing the board and management with independent, risk-based, and objective assurance, advice, insight, and foresight. We are consumed with the goal of moving as fast as the business, being powered by technology, and increasing the maturity of Stripe’s controls where it matters the most.

Our IA team is responsible for providing objective assurance on the design and operational effectiveness of Stripe’s internal controls and business processes, its compliance with laws and regulations, its risk management framework, and other governance processes. Organized as a single global function, the team operates under a unified methodology, set of policies, and governance model — with specialized leads who bring deep domain expertise while working in alignment with that shared framework. We’re looking for a leader with extensive finance, operations, fiduciary, and regulatory compliance audit experience who will help us build and scale a global audit program.

What you’ll do

As a senior member of the EMEA IA team you will be central to shaping our audit landscape in one of the most dynamic sectors of FinTech. In this pivotal role, you will help drive the execution of a comprehensive, risk-based internal audit strategy that not only anticipates emerging risks but also aligns seamlessly with our management's vision and regulatory landscape.

As a member of the Internal Audit team, you will harness your expertise in governance, risk management, and internal controls to produce invaluable assessments that empower our Board, Audit Committee, and senior leadership to make informed, strategic decisions. This is more than just an auditing position; it's an opportunity to influence the very framework of our operations, protect our organization from unforeseen challenges, and bolster our commitment to excellence and compliance in the rapidly evolving world of Fintech. If you're looking to make a significant impact and elevate your career in an innovative and supportive environment, this is your chance to step into a role where your insights will drive meaningful change and ensure our continued success.

This position is office-based in London, UK.

Responsibilities

Lead and execute risk-based internal audits and provide input into a risk-based internal audit strategy that ensures comprehensive, end-to-end audit coverage. This strategy should reflect emerging risks, management priorities, and regulatory obligations. 

Oversee evaluation and testing of governance, risk management, internal controls, compliance, financial reporting, and operational processes to ensure their effectiveness, accuracy, and regulatory compliance.

Present independent, objective reports directly to the UK Board, Audit Committee, and senior leadership on the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, and governance processes, communicating complex technical and regulatory risks to senior stakeholders in clear, actionable terms.

Ability to engage with partners and regulators; help prepare and present audit evidence and findings to enhance confidence in our internal oversight processes.

Clearly communicate complex risks and impacts to senior stakeholders, including the Board, Audit Committee, and regulators (e.g., FCA, CBI).

Partner with senior management and cross-functional teams - including engineering, product, treasury, legal, compliance, and operations - to translate audit findings into durable, structured remediation plans with control enhancements, tracking all corrective actions to verified closure.

Invest in understanding the business to better identify areas of need and opportunities to advise.

Research and stay current on applicable regulatory requirements and (e.g., GAAP, IFRS, PSD2, EMD2, EBA, etc.), emerging trends and best practices. 

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

8+ years of experience in internal auditing, risk management, or compliance, preferably within the banking or financial services sector.

Expertise in auditing financial controls, operations and regulatory compliance.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.

Strong experience in risk-based audit planning, execution, and reporting across governance, compliance, financial reporting, and operational controls.

Professional certification such as CIA, CPA, CAMS, CRCM or similar is required (or active pursuit).

Strong analytical skills with experience using data analytics and continuous monitoring tools to support audit activities.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex issues clearly to non-technical senior stakeholders.

Proven ability to lead cross-functional remediation efforts and track closure of corrective actions.

High degree of integrity, independence, and professional skepticism.

Preferred qualifications

Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, MBA, or related advanced degree.

Prior experience in a regulated financial institution or network with complex relationships among network partners.

Experience with audit management software, automation platforms, and advanced data analytics.

Demonstrated track record of building continuous audit/monitoring programs.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Machine Learning - Credit Risk
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager, Machine Learning Credit Risk

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Credit Risk team develops intelligent systems that help Stripe identify high-risk accounts, minimize credit losses, and improve profitability. Credit risk is a complex machine learning problem that requires us to distinguish emerging risk from healthy business activity while giving legitimate users a clear and reliable experience.

Our team consists of machine learning engineers who build models and systems used across Stripe’s credit-risk products. We work closely with partners in Product, Data Science, Credit Strategy, Operations, and other engineering teams. Together, we help stakeholders make informed decisions and support sustainable growth wherever credit risk affects Stripe’s products.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead the Credit Risk team and shape how Stripe uses machine learning to manage credit risk at scale. You’ll set the team’s technical and product direction, connect advances in machine learning to measurable business outcomes, and help engineers deliver reliable systems that balance loss prevention with the user experience.

You’ll work across engineering, product, data science, and risk to identify the highest-impact opportunities and turn them into a focused roadmap. You’ll also hire and develop engineers, strengthen the team’s technical practices, and contribute to machine learning and engineering leadership across Stripe.

Responsibilities

Set and execute the strategy for detecting and mitigating credit risk through machine learning

Own outcomes related to credit losses, profitability, detection quality, and the user experience

Lead the design and delivery of reliable machine learning models, services, and decision systems

Translate advances in machine learning into practical capabilities that support the team’s business goals

Partner with Product, Data Science, Credit Strategy, Operations, and engineering teams to define priorities and deliver cross-functional programs

Recruit, hire, and develop machine learning engineers while building an inclusive and effective team

Contribute to broader engineering and machine learning initiatives as a member of Stripe’s engineering management team

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

3+ years of experience managing engineers who build and operate production machine learning systems

Experience applying machine learning to complex, real-world problems and leading the technical delivery of models and supporting systems

Experience setting strategy and working across engineering, product, data science, operations, and business teams to deliver measurable outcomes

Experience recruiting, managing, and developing engineers in a fast-moving environment with significant autonomy

Preferred qualifications

Experience with credit risk, fraud detection, financial risk, trust and safety, or another domain involving decisions under uncertainty

Experience balancing risk reduction with customer or user experience

Experience building machine learning systems that support high-stakes, time-sensitive decisions at scale

Experience setting a multi-year technical direction while delivering progress through quarterly plans

Experience managing geographically distributed teams

About the team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Product Support Operations (PSO) team plays a key role in efficiently solving our users’ issues. As part of our PSO team, you will be a critical driver in delivering exceptional user experiences. This role goes beyond basic troubleshooting—it's about using your technical expertise, analytical mindset, and project management skills to strategically improve our support systems, processes, and product quality. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.

Our Quality team sits at the heart of that mission. We are responsible for defining and upholding the standards that shape every user interaction across our support verticals. We believe that quality is not just a score — it is a reflection of the care and expertise we bring to every user, every time.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will own quality outcomes at your site, leading a team of approximately 6 Quality Analysts spanning multiple support verticals. Your team plays a critical role in upholding the quality standards that underpin the experience we deliver to Stripe's users and you will be the person who drives that standard forward at your site.

Beyond your team, you will serve as a key voice in the evolution of our quality program and a strategic partner to vertical leads. To be a great fit, you will have a quality first mindset, the ability to translate data into action, a track record of coaching others to grow, and the cross functional credibility to influence without authority across a multi vertical environment.

Responsibilities

Own UIQ quality scores across all verticals at your site, driving teams to meet and sustain a minimum 90% quality score

Serve as the final escalation layer for Disputes at your site, ensuring fair, consistent, and well reasoned outcomes

Review quality trends for each vertical at your site, identifying patterns and surfacing risks before they become issues

Complete case work to stay close to the day to day realities of the verticals’ subject matter and maintain subject matter familiarity

Participate in calibration sessions across verticals to drive alignment and consistency in scoring

Help lead rubric updates and contribute to the continuous evolution of our quality framework

Drive projects at the quality program level, contributing to broader initiatives that improve how quality is measured and managed across PSO

Deliver high-level quality reporting for all verticals at your site, providing leadership with a clear and actionable view of performance

Provide insights and recommendations back to vertical leads, translating quality data into concrete operational guidance

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

About the team

The Builder Experience Team makes it easier for Stripe’s product teams to build the right products, ship them with confidence, and help users realize value from them.

In order to build a great product, product teams must develop a deep understanding of users, shape and test ideas, coordinate across functions, navigate launch requirements, identify risks, gather feedback, and manage products after launch. Today, many of these workflows are fragmented, manual, or built around processes and tools that predate recent advances in AI.

We are a small, AI-native team reimagining how Stripe builds, ships, and ramps products. We experiment with new approaches across AI agents, automation, and process—and scale the ones that work. Our initial areas of focus include reinventing launch readiness from gates into guidelines, giving product teams richer and more timely context, and shortening the feedback loops between builders, users, Sales, and Support.

Our users are Stripe’s product managers, engineers, designers, researchers – and we help to simplify the interactions with the cross-functional teams that help bring products to market. We work closely with teams including all of our business unit PMs, Product Operations, and Kai, Stripe’s internal AI platform.

What you'll do

We’re looking for product-minded engineers who want to rethink how products get built—not simply digitize existing processes. You’ll identify high-friction parts of Stripe’s product-development lifecycle, rapidly prototype new approaches, put them in the hands of real teams, and turn the strongest experiments into scaled solutions used by every product team at Stripe.

This is a hands-on role with broad product and technical scope. You’ll work across the stack, combining traditional software engineering with emerging AI capabilities. You’ll operate in ambiguous problem spaces where the right product, interface, and technical architecture must be discovered together.

You will:

Design and build tools that help Stripe teams shape better products, ship with greater speed and confidence, and learn from users more quickly.

Develop AI-native workflows and agents that synthesize context, automate repetitive work, surface risks, and help builders make better decisions.

Own projects end to end: identify high-value problems, develop prototypes, test them with users, measure their impact, and scale the approaches that work.

Work across backend systems, data sources, internal platforms, and polished user-facing experiences.

Partner directly with product managers, engineers, designers, researchers, and cross-functional teams to understand how work happens in practice.

Integrate with platforms such as Kai and Compass while identifying where new foundational capabilities are needed.

Apply strong judgment to the use of sensitive internal context, including appropriate attention to security, privacy, permissions, and user trust.

Help define how the team operates, including its technical foundations, product-development practices, and standards for experimentation and quality.

Contribute to the team’s roadmap by identifying systemic sources of friction and opportunities to improve Stripe’s product-development lifecycle.

5+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience

Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience building reliable backend services and polished user-facing product experiences.

Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, experimenting & adjusting, making right-sized technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward.

Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints.

Strong engineering judgment around system reliability, operational excellence, security, and maintainability.

A product-minded approach to engineering, with a focus on delivering meaningful outcomes for users and the business.

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer, Abuse Control
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Control Engineering (ACE) is Stripe’s rapid-response technical defense and control incubator. When urgent abuse vectors emerge, ACE uses real-world attacker telemetry to prototype, test, and deploy software safeguards before vulnerabilities can be exploited at scale.

We partner closely with Fraud, Risk, Abuse Research, and Product Engineering to run rigorous experiments that balance effective risk mitigation with legitimate user activity and conversion. Operating as both a strike team and an incubator, ACE builds automated regression suites to prevent threats from recurring and transfers mature controls to long-term product owners across Stripe.

What you’ll do

As an Abuse Control Engineer on the ACE team, you will design, prototype, and incubate technical defenses that safeguard Stripe’s financial ecosystem against complex, cross-cutting abuse vectors.

When emerging threat patterns reveal weaknesses in Stripe products, ACE rapidly builds and experiments with technical safeguards. Guided by empirical evidence and Stripe’s Fraud Taxonomy 3.0 (FT3) framework, you will translate threat intelligence into precise technical control requirements, such as API rate limits, step-up challenges, parameter validation, and pre-debit holds.

You will run experiments to evaluate risk reduction against the impact on legitimate user conversion, carefully balancing security and product velocity. You will manage controls through a structured incubation lifecycle, build automated regression suites to prevent threats from recurring, and partner with product engineering teams to transfer mature, long-term defenses.

Responsibilities

Rapid control prototyping: Design, prototype, and deploy technical controls across API, protocol, and product boundaries to address high-impact abuse vectors.

Evidence-based technical requirements: Translate empirical attacker evidence and FT3 threat research from Abuse Research, Fraud, and Security teams into precise technical abuse requirements and control specifications.

Control co-design: Collaborate with teams across Stripe to design resilient, secure controls across payments, onboarding, identity, and Connect surfaces.

Risk experimentation: Run rigorous experiments and A/B tests to measure risk reduction against the impact on legitimate user conversion, optimizing controls to minimize friction while neutralizing threats.

Regression testing: Build comprehensive regression test suites and automated attack simulations with Abuse Research to ensure mitigated abuse vectors do not recur.

Stakeholder management: Execute ACE’s incubation model by defining handoff criteria, operational documentation, timelines, and target dates for transferring successful controls to product teams.

Who you are

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Early Career — Immediate Start
jobs.description:
This role is for applicants actively looking to start before December 1, 2026.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

Your role

Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.

To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.

Who you are

Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 

Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

Must be available to start full-time before December 1, 2026

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a directly related field, obtained by summer 2026, or equivalent work experience

New grad candidates should have no more than 18 months of professional experience (excluding internship experience)

Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.

Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting).

Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.

Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge. 

Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems.

Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases.

Experience leading small projects independently, and contributing to larger projects alongside peers.

Ability to operate with high agency in navigating complex technical obstacles independently, knowing precisely when to unblock oneself and when to ask for help.

The Financial Crime, Compliance and Risk Oversight (FinCRO) Investigations Management team provides second-line-of-defence (2LoD) financial crime risk oversight and coordinates casework across Stripe’s EMEA region. The team manages user risk and synthesises investigative information into decision-ready analysis and intelligence for MLROs, RCOs, and other key stakeholders. It also identifies control weaknesses, coordinates complex investigations, and supports local examinations and inquiries from financial partners, law enforcement, and other external stakeholders.

As an Investigator on the EMEA Investigations Management team, you will:

Review high-risk investigative casework and provide 2LoD oversight across a wide variety of financial crime risk types

Prepare and submit Luxembourg Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to the Cellule de renseignement financier (CRF) for Bridge Building S.A., working closely with the MLRO and in line with established governance

Oversee local customer risk decisions for Bridge Building S.A., including matters escalated through country- or entity-specific risk management forums, in close partnership with the MLRO and Investigations Leads

Review high-risk sanctions investigations, such as potential matches against relevant regional lists, and handle related submissions

Use and evolve AI and agentic tools to enhance casework research and analysis, surface actionable intelligence, and improve investigative workflows while applying expert judgement and maintaining human oversight of risk decisions and regulatory filings

Assess casework to produce clear investigative analyses, intelligence briefs, and other decision-ready outputs that identify threats, support reporting workstreams, and inform MLROs, RCOs, and other stakeholders

Identify potential control gaps through casework analysis and recommend solutions to mitigate financial crime risks across the programme and in individual cases

Serve as a point of contact for investigation-related inquiries from law enforcement and FIUs, financial partners, auditors, and other external stakeholders

Demonstrate sound judgement and the ability to navigate complex, high-risk cases where the correct decision may not be immediately clear

Who you are

3+ years of experience in investigative roles within financial crime, AML, risk, intelligence research, or a related field

Fluency in English and French

Demonstrated experience preparing regulatory disclosures, including direct experience with Luxembourg STR filings and goAML

A deep understanding of financial technologies, including payments, cryptocurrency, stablecoins, and Banking-as-a-Service products

Strong knowledge of Luxembourg and EU AML, terrorist financing, and sanctions regulations

Stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with MLROs and communicate complex risk decisions clearly

Excellent research and writing skills and the ability to produce concise, decision-ready investigative outputs

The ability to synthesise large amounts of information, including transaction data, using tools such as SQL, Excel, and AI

The ability to work efficiently and independently in a fast-paced environment

The ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion

Technical curiosity and an interest in evolving financial crime compliance trends

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working across disciplines: part solution developer, part data architect, part workflow designer, and part coach. What you’ll do

You'll work side-by-side with Finance subject matter experts to understand how work gets done, identify the highest impact opportunities, and partner with domain teams to chart a transformation plan which balances future ambitions with rapid impact. You'll work independently to automate manual processes, design and build agents and required data solutions using internal platforms, and enable Finance teams to maintain these solutions long-term.

You’ll help colleagues move from a manual workflow, to a first AI-enabled win, to a reliable solution they can confidently operate and improve themselves. Success means the workflow stays transformed after the initial build, the team trusts the output, and the people closest to the process can own what comes next. 

You’ll favor learning through building. When possible, you’ll put a useful prototype in front of a Finance user, test it against a real deliverable, and improve it quickly rather than spend weeks describing a theoretical future state. When you encounter platform limitations—which you will—you’ll find creative, supportable approaches, collaborate with Engineering to scope and test custom tools, and escalate strategically when needed.

This role requires a blend of process automation, data operations, technical problem-solving, and stakeholder enablement. You'll spend your time building agents, optimizing data pipelines that feed them, creating knowledge layers that make them more accurate, and training Finance teams to use and maintain them. jobs.title: Product Manager - Issuance, Bridge
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the team

Join our Issuance Product team to shape the future of financial access and infrastructure. We're not just improving global payments, we're reinventing them with modern rails that allow for fast, cheap transactions at any size. You will build a platform that powers issuing compliant stablecoins in US/EU and beyond. We work with some of the largest fintechs, crypto companies, blockchains and more. This is your chance to lead meaningful innovation from day one, redefining the way businesses and people exchange value globally.

What you’ll do

Empathy for users: You’re passionate about uncovering and solving pain points.

Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss—from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.

What You'll Do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.

Responsibilities

Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Radar product suite to accelerate opportunities globally

Demonstrate a deep understanding of trends in the fraud and risk management ecosystem, including AI-powered detection, processor-agnostic architectures, and the shift from payment fraud to holistic business risk (policy abuse, account takeover, first-party misuse)

Develop expertise with the functional and architectural patterns for deploying advanced fraud systems, including the lifecycle of rule management, ML model tuning, and manual review optimization

Understand the ecosystem of risk and identity integrations (device fingerprinting, identity verification, bot mitigation, case management) Stripe must support for users to be successful

Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team

Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback

Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships

Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features

Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors

Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team

Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation

Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety

Deep working knowledge of the fraud and risk ecosystem, including payment fraud (CNP), account takeover (ATO), first-party misuse (friendly fraud), and policy/content abuse

Demonstrated knowledge of risk management architectures, including the role of rules engines, machine learning models, and manual review queues in fraud decisioning

Strong knowledge of the signals and data used in fraud detection: device/IP data, behavioral biometrics, identity verification, and graph-based analysis

Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact

Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners

Experience with processor-agnostic fraud solutions and multi-processor payment environments

Experience with risk management for platforms/marketplaces, subscription services, and digital goods

Familiarity with liability shift programs (chargeback guarantees) and value-based pricing models for risk products

Understanding of how to extend fraud protection across the payment lifecycle—payouts (Issuing), in-person (Terminal), or recurring (Billing)

Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

The People Systems Operations Administrator supports the day-to-day work that keeps Stripe’s People technology running accurately and reliably. The role sits in the Service Delivery Center and works as part of the wider People Solutions team, with a close dotted-line partnership to People Solutions Systems Management.

You’ll own a defined set of routine tier 1 and tier 2 operational work across Workday and related People Systems. This includes monitoring support channels and system inboxes, triaging requests, completing repeatable administrative tasks, maintaining documentation, and routing complex issues to the right People Systems owner.

This is a hands-on operations role. It creates clearer separation between routine support work and the configuration, architecture, governance, and project delivery owned by the People Systems team.

What you’ll do

Support queue and request triage

 Monitor the Salesforce case management queue and Jira requests for People Systems work.

Triage incoming requests by urgency, business impact, data sensitivity, and defined support process.

Resolve standard requests using documented procedures, and route exceptions or higher-complexity work to the appropriate People Systems owner.
Keep request records accurate and complete, including status updates, required approvals, supporting documentation, and clear handoffs.

Identify recurring request patterns and flag opportunities to improve documentation, self-service, or system processes.

Workday operations 

Monitor the Workday inbox for business process errors, stuck transactions, alerts, and other operational issues.

Complete routine Workday support tasks, including standard access requests, account maintenance, and operational follow-up.

Support Salesforce and JIRA run work and respond to common People Systems questions using approved guidance.

Help with recurring operational tasks such as account monitoring, account resets, and quarterly account reviews.

Support year-end activity, including schedule extensions, alert configuration, audit requests, and tracking follow-up items.

Assist with release readiness by reviewing assigned Workday updates, completing test steps, documenting results, and escalating issues found during testing.

Support recurring People programs, such as performance-cycle launches, using established runbooks and checklists.

Reporting, documentation, and Jira support 

Intake and triage Workday reporting and data requests. Confirm required information, route requests to the right owner, and provide status updates to requesters.

Complete standard reporting tasks and access-related requests where there is a documented process and appropriate approval.

Maintain runbooks, Trailhead content, standard operating procedures, and request templates so guidance stays current and easy to find.

Support data-quality checks and follow established processes to correct or escalate issues.

Partnership with People Systems 

Work closely with People Systems analysts and engineers to understand support priorities, upcoming releases, recurring work, and escalation paths.

Provide clear handoffs for work that requires configuration changes, advanced reporting, integrations, security decisions, or policy interpretation.

Participate in regular reviews of queue trends, service levels, documentation gaps, and operational risks.

Build platform knowledge over time, with opportunities to take on more complex administration and configuration work as skills develop.

Minimum requirements

Experience in People operations, HR administration, systems support, service delivery, or another operations role involving high-volume, process-driven work.

Strong attention to detail, particularly where accuracy affects People records, access, payroll, compliance, or reporting.

Ability to work through a queue independently, prioritize requests, follow defined processes, and escalate issues at the right time.

Clear written communication and comfort giving requesters concise status updates.

Experience using Jira, Salesforce, or a similar case-management or ticketing tool.

Comfort learning enterprise systems and following structured procedures across multiple tools.

Strong organization skills and a consistent approach to documenting work and following requests through to resolution.

Good judgment when working with confidential information.

Preferred qualifications

Experience supporting Workday, including Core HCM, business processes, security administration, reporting, or Workday inbox monitoring.

Experience handling reporting requests, data access requests, and standard user provisioning.

Experience supporting cyclical People programs, compliance activities, audit requests, or system-release testing.

What success looks like

Within the first six months, you will:

Own the defined tier 1 and routine tier 2 People Systems queue work with accurate, timely resolution and clear escalation.

Establish dependable monitoring for People Systems tickets in Salesforce, JIRA, the Workday inbox, and recurring operational tasks.

Reduce avoidable handoffs and ensure complex work reaches the right People Systems owner with the context needed to act.

Keep core runbooks and self-service guidance current based on recurring request patterns.

Give People Systems analysts and engineers more capacity for configuration, governance, architecture, and strategic delivery work.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Foreign Exchange
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, manage their businesses, and grow their revenue. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. You’ll have an opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach. 

About the team

The Foreign Exchange team builds the products and infrastructure that help Stripe users operate across currencies. Businesses increasingly operate globally from the moment they launch, collecting revenue, holding balances, paying suppliers, and managing expenses across multiple currencies.

Managing those currencies remains fragmented. Finance teams must decide what to hold, when to convert, how to manage currency exposure, and how to reconcile the results. Today, these workflows often span banks, spreadsheets, treasury systems, and specialist FX providers.

Stripe is uniquely positioned to simplify this. We sit at the center of the payments, Billing, balances, payouts, and settlement flows that create a business’s currency needs. Our vision is to make Stripe the financial home for businesses operating internationally, with a unified offering for holding, converting, and managing currencies and FX risk.

A core part of this vision is making currency management agentic. We believe software agents will increasingly help businesses understand their FX position, recommend actions, and manage currencies within defined policies and controls.

This could include Stripe-native agents that monitor exposure and take approved actions. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s infrastructure to understand balances and exposures, obtain pricing, execute conversions or hedges, and reconcile the results.

Our goal is to make Stripe the currency-management layer that both people and agents can build on.

We will build these capabilities both for globally operating businesses and for the platforms and marketplaces that use Connect.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Product Manager to build a new area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering. This is a zero-to-one product role at the intersection of FX, treasury, and agentic AI. You will help define what agentic currency management should look like. That could mean Stripe-native agents that understand exposure, recommend actions, and execute within customer-defined policies. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s FX infrastructure to understand balances, obtain pricing, manage risk, execute transactions, and reconcile the results.

You will work directly with globally operating businesses to understand their most important currency-management problems. You will identify the right initial product wedge and take it from discovery through launch and iteration. Today, treasury teams assemble exposures from multiple systems, determine hedge requirements, monitor changing positions, request pricing, execute trades, and reconcile the results. We believe much of this workflow can become continuous, intelligent, and increasingly automated.

You might build products that combine Stripe’s real-time view of payments, balances, and settlement activity with customer forecasts and policies to identify exposures and recommend actions. You might also define the APIs, permissions, controls, and financial primitives that allow customer or third-party agents to safely take those actions through Stripe.

Over time, these systems could move from surfacing insights to requesting quotes, executing conversions or hedges, rebalancing positions, and escalating exceptions within clearly defined permissions.

You will determine which intelligence Stripe should provide directly, which capabilities we should expose for others to build on, where humans should remain in the decision loop, and how we evaluate whether agents are making good decisions. Your product area could also include automated conversion and balance policies, recurring currency-management workflows, or capabilities distributed through Connect.

The opportunity is broad. Your job will be to make it focused. You will determine where Stripe can create differentiated value, build the first product, measure whether it works, and use those learnings to shape the roadmap.

You will work closely with Engineering and Design on product experiences, APIs, data models, agent behavior, controls, and system reliability. You will also partner with Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure the products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and ready for customers.

 

Responsibilities

Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.

Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering.

Identify high-value customer problems and take new products from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

Define Stripe’s approach to agentic currency management, including Stripe-native experiences, agent-ready APIs, permissions, controls, and evaluation.

Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build simple, reliable products across user experiences, APIs, data models, and financial infrastructure.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Privy
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. We build simple, flexible application programming interfaces (APIs) and tools that help developers create products on crypto infrastructure.

Privy provides the abstraction and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across blockchain networks, third-party providers, and Stripe products such as Treasury and Link. We solve complex technical problems while using Stripe’s global reach to support customers including Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo. Our technology powers experiences for both mainstream users and crypto-native audiences.

Learn more: [Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone]

About the team

The Account Executive, Product team connects Privy’s technology with companies building new products across fintech and crypto. The team works closely with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market partners to understand prospective customers’ needs, shape technical and commercial solutions, and turn market insights into product and sales strategy. Its focus includes priority segments such as neobanking, payments, and brokerages. 

What you’ll do

As an Enterprise Account Executive you’ll own complex enterprise sales cycles and help expand Privy’s work with companies across fintech and crypto. You’ll build relationships with senior commercial and technical stakeholders, develop new opportunities, and help refine Privy’s enterprise sales approach. You’ll also contribute to Privy’s global growth strategy and represent the company at industry events.

Responsibilities

Partner with the Head of Go-to-Market (GTM) to build and close a strong pipeline of enterprise prospects.

Develop and test outbound campaigns based on market and customer feedback.

Manage a pipeline across multiple ideal customer profiles.

Build deep expertise in Privy’s products and lead discovery calls with fintech prospects to understand their needs and explain Privy’s value.

Own the full sales cycle, from sourcing opportunities through contract close, and serve as the primary commercial contact for prospective customers.

Contribute to the Go-to-Market team’s strategy across North America and other global markets, including Latin America, Asia, and Africa.

Analyze market trends and emerging opportunities to inform Privy’s positioning and sales strategy.

Represent Privy at industry events and conferences as a spokesperson for its fintech business.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

5 to 10 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related field, including experience selling a technical product and a record of strong performance.

You have experience selling technical products within fintech, crypto, or a related industry. You can build a pipeline, lead complex sales cycles, and develop trusted relationships with commercial and technical stakeholders.

Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals involving legal, compliance, engineering, and other buyer-side teams through contract close.

Ability to work effectively in an early-stage environment and build repeatable processes where none exist.

Experience building strong networks within a specific industry, ideally fintech, payments, or crypto.

Strong communication, negotiation, relationship management, and sales skills.

Preferred qualifications

Experience selling API-first or developer-focused products.

Ability to lead discovery conversations with technical buyers, including chief technology officers and product leaders.

Familiarity with crypto infrastructure, such as stablecoins, on-ramps and off-ramps, wallets, and custody, or a demonstrated ability to learn the space quickly.

jobs.title: Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Proactive Threat team is responsible for identifying vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across Stripe's systems, applications, networks, and cloud infrastructure — before adversaries do. We operate as a hybrid offensive function: conducting penetration testing, emulating real-world threat actors through red team operations, and partnering closely with our defensive security teams to validate detection capabilities and improve Stripe's overall security posture.

We are builders first. Our team develops custom tooling, automation frameworks, and internal platforms that scale our offensive capabilities and enable repeatable, high-fidelity assessments. We believe the best offensive security engineers are equal parts hacker and engineer.

The team is distributed across the United States, primarily operating in Eastern and Pacific time zones, and collaborates regularly with security, engineering, and product stakeholders across Stripe — including teams in Europe and Asia.

What you'll do

As an Offensive Security Engineer on the Proactive Threat team, you will simulate the tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) of real-world adversaries to uncover security risks across Stripe's products and infrastructure. You'll conduct hands-on penetration testing, lead red team engagements, and collaborate with blue team counterparts to validate and improve detection and response capabilities. Your work will directly influence how Stripe builds, ships, and secures financial infrastructure used by millions of businesses worldwide.

Beyond assessments, you'll design and build offensive tooling and automation that amplifies the team's impact. You'll leverage threat intelligence to prioritize testing efforts, contribute to incident investigations when needed, and act as a subject-matter expert for security initiatives across the company.

Responsibilities

Conduct comprehensive penetration tests across web applications, APIs, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), mobile applications, and internal infrastructure

Plan and execute red team engagements that emulate the TTPs of cyber and criminal threat actors targeting financial services, including initial access, lateral movement, persistence, and data exfiltration scenarios

Perform assumed-breach and objective-based assessments to test detection and response capabilities in coordination with defensive teams

Partner with detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response teams to validate security controls, identify coverage gaps, and improve detection fidelity

Contribute adversary tradecraft insights to inform detection rule development, threat hunting hypotheses, and incident response playbooks

Support incident investigations by providing offensive expertise, log analysis, and root cause analysis when required

Design, develop, and maintain custom offensive tools, scripts, and automation frameworks to enhance assessment efficiency and coverage

Build internal platforms and workflows that enable scalable, repeatable offensive operations

Contribute to internal security tooling repositories and champion engineering best practices within the team

Automate repetitive testing tasks, payload generation, and reporting workflows using modern development practices

Produce clear, actionable reports that communicate technical findings, business risk, and remediation guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Act as a subject-matter expert and primary point of contact for stakeholder teams engaged in offensive security programs and Stripe-wide security initiatives

Lead offensive security projects end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing

Stay current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques; share research internally and contribute to the broader security community

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

5+ years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming, or a related field

Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with demonstrated experience building tools, automation, or custom exploits

Deep knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, and common vulnerability classes (injection, auth flaws, business logic, etc.)

Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including cloud-native attack techniques and misconfigurations

Proficiency with offensive tooling such as Burp Suite, Cobalt Strike, Mythic, Sliver, BloodHound, or similar frameworks

Familiarity with adversary tradecraft and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, including TTPs for initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and exfiltration

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, risk-based recommendations

Ability to think like an adversary — creative, persistent, and able to holistically assess risk in complex environments

Preferred qualifications

Experience conducting offensive security in fintech, financial services, or other highly regulated environments

Background in vulnerability research, exploit development, or CVE discovery

Experience collaborating with threat intelligence, detection engineering, or incident response teams (purple team operations)

Familiarity with big data and log analysis tools (Splunk, Databricks, PySpark, osquery, etc.) for threat hunting or investigative support

Proficiency with AI/LLM-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and experience applying them to offensive security workflows

Interest or experience in agentic automation — using LLMs or autonomous agents to augment reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, or exploitation workflows

Experience testing AI/ML systems or LLM-based applications for security weaknesses (prompt injection, training data extraction, model manipulation, etc.)

Contributions to open-source security tools, published research, blog posts, or conference presentations

Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, OSED, CRTO, CPTS, PNPT, GXPN, or cloud security certifications

Location

This role is remote within the United States. While you are welcome to visit Stripe offices for team meetings, on-sites, and events, our expectation is that you would regularly work from home. The team primarily coordinates across Eastern and Pacific time zones, with regular collaboration with stakeholders in Europe and Asia.

Compensation & Benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $170,400 – $255,700. This range may span multiple career levels and will be refined during the interview process based on experience, qualifications, and location.

Additional benefits include:

Equity participation in Stripe's growth

401(k) plan with matching contributions from day one

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

Wellness stipends

Annual budget for training, certifications, and conference attendance

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Accounting Products
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Accounting Products team is building modern infrastructure for the Office of the CFO. Our vision is to give finance teams, and the agents that support them, one reconciled and explainable presentation of financial truth.

Today, the data and context required to make accounting decisions are fragmented across billing systems, contracts, spreadsheets, general ledgers, and the minds of the people doing the work. Finance teams spend significant time reconstructing what happened, determining the appropriate accounting treatment, reconciling results, and gathering evidence. Giving an agent access to the underlying data is not enough: it also needs the business context, accounting policies, approved judgments, and guardrails required to act reliably.

Revenue Recognition is our first major proof point. Stripe has a unique opportunity to help Billing and Metronome users turn complex revenue activity—including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications—into accurate, explainable journal entries. Our ambition is for agents to take on the investigation, configuration, and repetitive work while accountants retain control over consequential judgments and approvals.

Over time, we expect to expand into additional Office of the CFO workflows, and we are looking for a Staff Product Manager to help turn this vision into products that finance teams trust. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership, autonomy, and influence across Product, Engineering, Design, Finance, Data Science, and Go-to-Market teams.

What you’ll do

You’ll own a significant product area within Accounting Products, setting its strategy, roadmap, and measures of success. You’ll translate the broader product vision into a focused plan, taking it from customer discovery and early prototypes through scaled adoption.

You’ll help build the future of agentic accounting: products that help finance teams automate work, understand financial results, and resolve exceptions while retaining control. Your work will connect Stripe’s Revenue Suite with the external systems customers rely on to manage their accounting workflows.

Responsibilities

Define a focused product strategy, initial customer market, and roadmap, making explicit choices about where Stripe has an advantage, what to prioritize, and what not to build, and revising those choices as evidence changes

Work directly with controllers, accountants, finance leaders, auditors, and implementation partners to understand accounting workflows, including month-end close, and translate customer problems into clear product requirements

Define how humans and agents work together to configure accounting policies, explain results, investigate exceptions, and propose or execute resolutions, with appropriate review, approvals, controls, and audit trails

Shape Revenue Recognition for Stripe Billing and Metronome users, supporting accurate journal entries and revenue schedules for usage-based pricing, credits, minimum commitments, contract modifications, and other complex business models

Build products that are accurate, explainable, and operationally reliable, with results traceable to source activity, accounting treatment, and supporting evidence, and measure success through accurate closes, accepted outputs, time savings, reliable general-ledger handoffs, adoption, and retention

Take products from prototype to scale with design partners, deciding what to standardize, automate, or keep narrow, and define integrations with general ledgers, ERP, customer relationship management, and professional-services platforms

Align senior stakeholders and partner with Billing, Metronome, Tax, Payments, and other teams to make financial results consistent across products, raising the quality of product thinking through clear writing, sound judgment, and constructive challenge

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

10+ years of product management experience delivering complex, technically or domain-intensive products, including as a senior individual contributor who independently sets direction, aligns cross-functional teams, and drives decisions without formal authority

Experience building products for finance, accounting, or similarly demanding domains where accuracy, controls, traceability, and trust are essential, with a high bar for correctness, explainability, reliability, and operability

Strong customer instincts and experience working directly with specialized users to uncover underlying needs and translate domain complexity into coherent products, supported by an understanding of complex systems, data models, APIs, integrations, and technical tradeoffs

Strong strategic judgment and experience taking products from ambiguity to execution: identifying differentiated advantages, defining initial markets, sequencing multi-year opportunities, and connecting strategy to detailed requirements, data analysis, and delivery

Excellent written and verbal communication and collaborative leadership across technical, business, and go-to-market teams, with the ability to clarify complex problems, align stakeholders, surface risks, and make or revise decisions as evidence changes in high-stakes environments

Preferred qualifications

Experience building accounting products for controllers, accounting teams, or other users in the Office of the CFO 

Working knowledge of revenue recognition under ASC 606 or IFRS 15, particularly for usage-based pricing, variable consideration, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications

Experience building AI or agent-powered products that investigate information, explain recommendations, or take action within defined controls and human review or approval workflows

Familiarity with general ledgers and ERP systems, such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, or Xero, including the integrations and operational processes needed to transfer and reconcile financial results

An accounting background CPA qualification, or experience partnering closely with accounting policy, controllership, or audit teams

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

The Compute Foundation group builds and operates the core systems that enable every Stripe engineer to ship code, configuration, and infrastructure changes safely and at high velocity. Embedded on the Imaging team, you will design, build, and distribute Linux machine images; manage host bootstrapping and OS-configuration systems; oversee OS packages and security-patching infrastructure; and provide platforms that empower service teams to safely run workloads across cloud providers and regions.

What you’ll do

Own the foundation of Stripe’s compute fleet: Stripe’s services rely on host infrastructure that boots reliably, receives accurate configurations, and operates safely. Your decisions will directly shape the base operating system, package ecosystems, security posture, and bootstrap behavior of Stripe’s fleet.

Lead active architectural transformations: The team is driving key platform evolutions, including modernizing the OS configuration layer, containerizing workloads, scaling machine image distribution across multi-cloud regions, and streamlining OS upgrades and critical security patching.

Drive broad, end-to-end host lifecycle ownership: Work across the entire host lifecycle - from image construction, package distribution, kernel and OS configuration, early boot/systemd, storage, networking initialization, and workload readiness. You will tackle complex engineering challenges that balance reliability, security, compliance, developer experience, and performance.

Your judgment prevents fleetwide incidents: Changes to machine images, packages, kernels, bootstrap systems, and host configuration can have broad consequences. You will design validation, canarying, rollout, health-evaluation, and rollback mechanisms that contain blast radius and make foundational infrastructure changes safer.

Agency to shape technical strategy: As a Staff engineer, you will set technical direction for the team’s systems, author designs that span multiple teams, mentor engineers and be the person engineering managers and engineers rely on for the technical north-star.

Responsibilities

 Lead large, ambiguous infrastructure projects from initial design through production launch, broad adoption, and long-term operation. Define the architecture and success criteria, sequence the work, resolve technical ambiguity, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and shepherd projects to measurable impact.

Set technical direction for the evolution of Stripe’s host infrastructure, including how machine images are built, validated, distributed, and operated. Guide thoughtful decisions about when to containerize workloads and when host-based approaches remain appropriate.

Design systems and practices that make broad infrastructure changes safe and predictable. Establish strong validation, staged rollout, observability, and rollback capabilities. Build guardrails that prevent unhealthy changes from progressing and give operators clear, actionable information when failures occur.

Lead incident response for the systems the team owns. Systematically reduce operational toil and make reliability, security, debuggability, and maintainability first-class properties of the platform. 

Partner with technical leaders across infrastructure, security, compliance, and service teams to represent the Imaging team’s perspective and align on shared technical direction. Build strong relationships with partner teams and lead work that crosses organizational and system boundaries.

Lead critical design reviews and establish standards for the safety, reliability, operability, and usability of Stripe’s host infrastructure. Mentor senior engineers through high-stakes architectural decisions. Raise the quality of designs and implementations through hands-on coding, code review, debugging, and operational leadership.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of designing and shipping production infrastructure systems of significant scale and complexity. 

Proven ability to lead large, ambiguous infrastructure projects end-to-end - from technical design through delivery - including managing cross-team dependencies and coordinating migrations across many consuming teams. 

Deep expertise in Linux systems, including boot and initialization, systems, processes, networking, filesystems, storage, packages, and production debugging.
Strong foundations in cloud compute infrastructure, including machine images, virtual machines, autoscaling fleets, launch configuration, block storage, IAM, health evaluation, and multi-region operation in AWS, Azure, or an equivalent environment.

Experience designing or operating fleet-scale image, host-management, configuration-management, or infrastructure-provisioning systems.

Experience with safe infrastructure rollout practices, including automated validation, canarying, progressive rollout, health evaluation, rollback, and blast-radius containment.

Strong background in service reliability and operational excellence: demonstrated ability to lead incident response, reduce toil, and build systems that are reliable, debuggable, and maintainable by a team. 

Track record of broad technical impact across multiple large systems: fluency across a complex codebase, force- multiplier effect through code review and mentorship, and the ability to set technical direction for a team rather than just execute within it. 

Preferred qualifications

Experience building modern image-based, immutable, or declarative infrastructure platforms.

Expertise with containers, Kubernetes, and migrating VM-based workloads to managed platforms

Experience operating large-scale Linux fleets across AWS, Azure, or multiple regions.

Familiarity with progressive delivery, automated validation, fleet health signals, and rollback systems.

Experience modernizing legacy configuration-management or host-provisioning systems.

Knowledge of OS security patching, software supply-chain security, and artifact provenance.

Strong developer-platform instincts, with experience building safe abstractions and self-service workflows.
